about: The Algorithm tab's Findings panel (admins only): what the research has learned, one line each. Each round appends entries; never edit the template. group: shipped | dropped | watching. sport: nfl | nba | nhl | mlb | mma, or null for every sport. ref: the DECISIONS.md entry.

entries.text: Trusted-piece bands: props' pieces proven, lines' not; no LOCK > LOVE > LIKE beyond noise (top edges lose again); staged only
MMA price swap fixed (mirrored opens repaired) and the favorite-longshot calibration on
Props priced on every season with prop odds: NBA record -10.1u to +29.3u
Practice picks are tracked only, never staked
Closing-line bands: LOVE/LOCK earned by beating the fair close with results that don't lose; the band lab stages rules first
News lag: teammates' points overs +9.4% on 1,700 at 6h, but hindsight-picked; earning live only
Timing: NBA/NHL line gaps worth +1-2% at 6h or more out, gone by 3h; no betting window earned yet
CLV bands: none earned yet; closest NBA early moneyline dogs (+1.6% shrunk, beat 51%)
Blowout props: the unders hit, but only win the vig back
MLB pitch caps: the Book already shades early-season starters
Props lagging line moves: they don't lag; taking the lagging side lost 8%
Last-result overreaction: the Book doesn't overreact once the Bot's own lean is in
NFL lines bet earlier (24h to 1h, 2020-26): no hour beats the close; early dogs beat the fair close 60-65% but lose 13-17% flat
Best price across 9 US books vs DraftKings: 1-8 cents better, +0.5-1.6 pts flat ROI; no lines sport clearly green (noise)
Two-band trial: prop LIKEs staked by their trusted share (1u high, 0.5u low), step picked monthly: +44.1u to +51.2u out of sample
Two-band trial: 22 LOVEs (shots-on-goal unders) +3.1% vs LIKE -2.3% out of sample (±22 pts: a trial), -20.6u to -19.9u
LOVE at the owner's 2% Kelly floor: out of sample it loses (NBA 67 LOVEs -14.1% vs LIKE +1.3%); the trial's LOVE sits at 1-2%
Small winners: the NBA is one (+51.2u); no honest stake tweak turns the NFL (-27.0u), NHL (-19.9u) or MLB (-11.9u) positive
NBA LOVE by trusted share (rebound unders): +1.6% vs +1.0% on the first replay, -0.4% vs +2.2% re-recorded: held off
Bets now at the best US price: live, 68% of NBA sides beat DraftKings (~4c); the replay shops only where history has every book
Props replay walk-forward by season (D74 fit on the seasons it priced): props NBA +7u, NHL +6u, NFL -14u, MLB -6u
Shop-only lines need the month's minimum edge, else 0.5u: NHL +0.5u, NFL no change, off in NBA and MMA
News lag from prices alone (star prop pulled, teammates unmoved): no edge in any sport; NBA -5.5% on 5,516, beat fair close 16%
Props pieces (early exit, blowout minutes, fatigue, play type, on/off): no log-loss gain past noise walk-forward in any sport; held
Interceptions vs the defense's EPA allowed: -0.0025 log loss in 2025-26 (z 2.6), nothing in 2024; recheck with more rows
Bot's own losing stat+side (or line market+side) now 0.5u: NBA +25.1u, NHL +5.0u, MLB +5.9u, NFL +1.9u on the replay
Teams vs the close: no ATS/ML/total winner persists; season-to-season r near 0 in every sport, top fifth next year -7% to +2.5%
Team form windows (last 20/40/82, home/away, fav/dog, NFL coach+QB era): no test survives BH out of sample (best q 0.46)
Players beating their prop lines: season-to-season r near 0 in every stat but NBA rebounds; following the hot ones loses -2% to -10%
Player types (role change, newcomer, new team, late season, heavy minutes, home/away, streaks, line size): none beats break-even held out
The Bot's own record by player or team doesn't carry: NBA players it lost on went +4.7% on 281 next; no player shrink
NBA rebounds: a player's over/under lean carries a season (r 0.15, n 428); shift lowers log loss 0.6e-4 (2 SE); too small to ship
NBA PRA unders after a team change: +7.5% on 427 held out (z 1.7, tune n 108); recheck with more trades
NBA young players lean on their own season (prior weight cut, walk-forward): projections -7.8e-4 log loss (z 8), +21u replayed
NFL props against the Bot's own lean (own chance <50%) take 0.5u: +8.6u on the replay, same record
Young-player weighting held in NHL (0.0e-4), NFL (+10e-4 worse), MLB (+0.7e-4 worse): veteran-style priors fit them
Young players' anchor pull by experience: picks more pull, not less; NBA +0.2e-4 worse, NHL noise. Held
NHL props against own lean lose (-6.3% flat on 336) but the guard costs trial LOVE winners (-7.9u). Off
Weight misses (216 bouts, Wikipedia) a soft term: missers won 42.6% vs the model 50.5%; fits at 0 today, misses read live
Camp distance: ESPN names a gym (today's, no place) for 2,165 fighters; no free dated camp locations, not built
NBA win patterns: props on a day's rest and rising minutes win more; walk-forward LOVE +5.1% vs LIKE +1.2%, 2025-26 flips
Pattern bands (LOVE/LOCK by an earned segment) not beyond noise by season (z 1.2): staged on the Live/Staged switch
Practice picks tracked again: tagged at no stake, Algorithm tab shows Practice (as if 0.5u) and PASS (1u flat), never the record
MMA parlays add no edge: close favorites ~even (-0.7% DK), opens +1-5% inside noise; a parlay multiplies that edge and the swings. Not added
Big/elite camps (ESPN+Wikipedia, camp at the bout): won as the close said (elite 51.0% vs 51.9%), nothing beyond it. Not added
H1 wrestler vs elite BJJ: his takedown tries fall to 0.6-0.8x his norm, yet he wins as the model says (51% vs 53%). Not added
H2 two elite grapplers: takedown tries 0.71x norms, fewer go the distance (47% vs 51%), totals at the line (56.5% vs 58.0%, n 46). Not added
H3 small-sample kickboxers' TDD 70% vs 64% for others (model 60%), but 56% vs real wrestlers; the term held out flat. Not added
Pedigree (Wikipedia as of debut): page-havers won +9.9 pts vs model, the rest -14; a third had pages deleted. Survivor-biased. Not used
Pedigree terms (NCAA, BJJ, kickboxing, streak) made clean: worse 2014-19, -0.0009 log loss 2020-26, nothing past the close. Not added
Feeder leagues (ESPN-known, first 1-5 UFC bouts): DWCS +1.6 vs model, 53.9% vs 54.1% close (n 1081); no league past noise. Not added
Gusts beyond the reported wind on totals: walk-forward -0.22 ± 0.33 sq pts (2,237 games), vs Pinnacle -9 ± 9. Not added
Wind direction vs field (OSM bearings, 29 stadiums): crosswind -2.7 vs along -1.7 pts/10 mph, same within noise. Not added
Weather on props (pass/rec/rush yds, rush att): gusts, along/cross all |z|<2 held out. Longest catch, kicking not archived
Park-oriented wind out/in on totals -1.1 ± 0.8; on hits, total bases, Ks, outs nothing past the close. windOut stays as is
2+ OL out: -0.7 ± 0.8 pts beyond the count; 2+ WR, 2+ DBs out: noise or wrong way vs the close. No compounding term
Both centers out: spread +1.3 ± 1.6 (worse), total -5.6 ± 3.5 not every season; 3+ regulars out noise. Not added
2+ D out, backup goalie, b2b x backup x thin D: sides and totals all within noise of the close. Not added
Fatigue x personnel (NBA b2b x short rotation, NHL b2b x backup, MLB tired pen x short leash): none beats the close
Opp centers out -> points overs: -1.0 ± 0.4 log loss, z 2.3, every season, linear only. Under the 2.5 bar; recheck
Each opp D out -> shots/points overs: z 2.9 / 2.7, but 2026 worse, linear only (2+ adds 0). Recheck with 2026-27
Crosswind term reads 0 locally: facts.fields/wdir empty in main and audit caches. Measured: direction adds nothing
Sharp lag: a line pick waits while the Book's no-vig sits 1+ pt over Pinnacle's; prices improve +1.1-2.0 pts by 3h out
Sharp lag on: replay 1,993 -> 1,992 line bets, -30.18u -> -29.68u; NBA 1,238 -> 1,234, -1.63u -> +0.37u; MLB unchanged
Sharp lag in the NFL: +1.7u in the replay but fewer bets beat the fair close (69.9% -> 68.9%): D60's guard holds it
Overreaction: 193k line moves bet against at the post-move price run at the vig (-3% to -6% at the fair close); no reversal
Book-only moves retrace 10-48% by the close, still -1.9% to -3.5% vs the fair close; Pinnacle-backed moves never reverse
MMA's biggest moves: +4.3% vs the fair close against them (n 337) but -9.5% on results (D59's longshot shade)
Price direction for the Bot's gap picks: they worsen 55-69% of the time; waiting costs 1.4-3.6 pts, so they bet now
Team totals vs spread+total: within 0.5 pt 80%; the 44 off by 1+ pt are mixed, nothing past the vig
Team's points props summed vs implied team total: over hit 47.9-49.7% across every decile of the gap. No edge
QB pass yards/attempts vs game script: lines carry it (-0.2% a point of dog); residual bets -1.9% (71), -6.1% (193)
Preseason title odds vs play so far: fading the over-reputed loses (NFL -14% to -20%, NBA, NHL too). Not added
NFL with the reputation weeks 2-8: +5-12% ROI on 385 (5 of 7 seasons) but -4% at the fair close, 2026 -11.6%
